fixtureProvenance: Synthetic repository, release, tag and commit graph records follow the retained Gitea 1.23.4 Swagger. They are not observations of a business service.
repository: API-only personal and organization creation, template generation with complete tree comparison, edit with explicit false fields, and fork parent verification. Workspace publishing is deferred.
releases: Exact tag, target, notes, draft and prerelease verification. Deletion independently verifies release absence, retained tag state and unrelated releases.
notes: Declared local-composite result from complete commit history and exact ancestry boundaries, including merged branches and excluding the start tag ancestry. New tag targets use the resolved SHA.
effects: All named writes use the shared preview binding, operation grants, ordered dispatch, canonical replay guard and secret-free journal. Asset positionals and unsupported latest/discussion settings refuse before mutation.
artium: Opt-in. Standalone checks explicitly skip hosted proof when no frozen fixture is selected. Exact fixture revision, manifest digest, package digest and source head are recorded in external journey reports.
